set.description: A tested AI research-assistance layer with local and verified-free cloud providers, grounding, citation and numeric verification, injection defence, data-routing policy and mandatory human review; no paid inference and no AI on the public website. Canonical issue https://github.com/svtmzt/human-prosperity-initiative/issues/101. Gate: Internal research mode is operational with verified free OpenRouter models and a published held-out evaluation (automated agreement with HPI's own curated reference, not independent review). Local-model live testing is blocked: no local runtime was reachable from the build environment. Hosted public inference is not deployed: it needs a durable quota store, authentication and privacy/legal approval (#103). No AI output is published as evidence.
